layers.name: unit
layers.use: Pure configuration, formatting, state, layout, and component behavior. Run the narrow Vitest or node:test file first; use ./test.sh for the full non-LLM suite.

layers.name: interactive
layers.use: Behavior that only exists in a real terminal viewport, including focus, resize, fullscreen layout, and mouse interaction. Follow .pi/skills/interactive-testing.md.
layers.cost: Requires a tmux-driven interactive process but no paid model call when exercised with the faux provider.

notes: After code changes, npm run check is mandatory and must be clean. It is a static gate, not a replacement for the narrow behavioral check. Never run npm test; use a specific test or ./test.sh as AGENTS.md requires.
